requiredBeforeOperator: Parent committed audit184 and explicit geometry Go185
Reverify immutable C19 hash, hood face-slot indices and candidate registry
Preregister one bounded operator trial and resource/start clock
Freeze independent owner's three inherited coplanar candidate IDs and predicates; the pair NPZ currently contains only the eleven strict pairs

operation.acceptedFaceAncestry: Each changed original face slot records old/new source index triplet, physical quotient IDs, oriented quad perimeter and operator sequence
operation.failurePolicy: Freeze one partial or rejected final result; no fairing, vertex movement or expanded halo

outputProtocol.finalOutputs: One final GLB plus lossless index/ancestry NPZ and audit/trial JSON only after explicit stage authorization; no per-candidate GLB
outputProtocol.bin: Copy complete original BIN chunk byte-for-byte as prefix; append only new hood index buffer, with alignment padding; leave original index buffer present
jsonAllowedChanges: one appended index accessor with source index component type and unchanged triangle count
outputProtocol.jsonComparison: Recursive original JSON comparison permitting only listed changes; GLB JSON serialization bytes are not claimed exact
outputProtocol.exactOriginalArrays: All POSITION, NORMAL, TANGENT, TEXCOORD, COLOR, JOINTS, WEIGHTS, morph targets, inverse-bind arrays and all untouched indices/accessor bytes
outputProtocol.exactOriginalFields: All images/textures/material/PBR/sampler, node/skin/mesh transforms and non-index primitive fields
outputProtocol.boundaryLocks: 307 paired hood/body cycle,237 hood opening,65L/62R cuff cycles: original positions/alias indices/attributes and oriented physical edges unchanged
outputProtocol.normalsMorphBookkeeping: No normal/tangent/morph recomputation. Original vertex arrays and morph rows retain byte correspondence. Face ancestry changes local interpolation only; original normals may no longer equal new geometric face normals and require later independent quality judgment

finalGate.goal: Eleven strict source witness pairs become zero, no new hood/body/glove pairs and no adjacent/coplanar-overlap shortcut
finalGate.topology: Literal source Float32 positions; area>1e-12m2, noncollapsed edges, no duplicate faces or newly overincident physical edges, manifold/winding/component/boundary unchanged
finalGate.oldWitnessTracking: Retest original eleven face-slot pairs regardless of resulting shared-node class
finalGate.fullExportAudit: Reparse final GLB, byte-compare original BIN prefix and protected arrays/fields, validate all source face counts, full body-self rest count and whole hood versus unchanged body/gloves
finalGate.render: No render until stable audited export and parent authorization; matched neutral source settings only
finalGate.claims: No rig/animation readiness, game-ready or appearance score; parent judges silhouette
